page.notes: Several Greek words in the errata are printed in Greek letters and I could not read them with certainty: the word after "dux" (274. 1), the word at 393. 29 and the word at 416. 8 are marked illegible. The line at 274. 1 appears to be an italic Greek phrase; the word before it is printed in italic. Some corrections are handwritten or stroked through and were not transcribed. The page has no page number, running head or catchword.
